what: PA2 portfolio allocation · the chain's inputs on today's real data: heat (11 sectors, four legs, the names rising), the cohorts with T12's soundness, the rings' raw readings per member (comps way C, the fundamentals the comps field uses and the peers' medians, the analyst target, the revisions, the Geiger). chain.mjs runs how much to own → heat → ring → picks → the book in the page from this file, under the equalizer.

geiger_live.what: the Hub's live Geiger (composite, 7 rungs) for the 590 served symbols and the 44 sector funds

bars.what: daily bars (100) for the sector funds, SPY and every knockout name; rotation = the 72-session log return minus SPY's, in points (16 short); a cohort's rotation is its MEDIAN member's

funds.what: cap-weight = the mean of three families' sector funds (State Street XLx · iShares IYx · Vanguard Vxx); equal-weight = Invesco RSPx; bow tie = equal-weight − cap-weight

b1.what: B1 (3 Oct 2026) · the market bow tie per sector at the 2 Oct close: every computed name, equal-weight (ew) and cap-weight (cw), with B1's soundness verdict; copied from hub/b1-market-bowtie-20261003 data/market-bowtie-20261003.json, sectors only
b1.rule: sound = n with a reading ≥ 8 · standard error ≤ 0.10 · held on each of the 6 closes (T12's rule) · AND the names we read carry ≥ 90 % of the market value of the names that exist (B1's one neighbour) · thin = enough and steady but under-covered or disagreeing · not yet = too few or not steady

t12.what: T12 (3 Oct 2026) · Alan's cohorts today (the Hub's tabs, the registry) and the candidates, measured; facts only, nothing written
t12.rule: sound = n with a reading ≥ 8 · standard error ≤ 0.10 · held on each of the 6 closes 25 Sep – 2 Oct · biggest FMP industry ≥ 60 % or fund-defined

comps.what: C5: the business-first set (lines.mjs, revenue segments pulled on Fly 3 Oct), the field with MAD-3 outliers out per measure, PEG from forward growth, way C = the weighted median of every peer's implied price on every priced measure (field.mjs); one table read per cohort over the union of the members' sets

targets.what: analyst_target_news, kind TARGET, A4-cleaned (quality is null or ≠ quarantine), the split-checked target first; the firms' newest note inside 183 days → median, low, high, count; revision direction = raised − lowered over the firms with a note in the last 30 days against their previous note
